phases.title: Pre-flight: verify LAUNCH §§1–3 unchecked rows in the target environment
Secrets handoff: production JWT/DB/Redis/SMTP/storage/kubeconfig in out-of-band store
Promote: copy deploy-production.example.yml or helm values-production; apply image tag
Smoke: HTTPS /api/v1/health and /health/ready; login + RBAC spot-check
Rollback ready: previous Helm revision / image tag documented before promote
Sign-off: fill LAUNCH §7 Name/Date only after real Engineering/Operations/Product verification

pass_criteria: LAUNCH §§1–3 verified in production (not packaging alone)
Secrets never committed; handoff recorded in ops change log
§7 signed only with real names/dates after success
deferred: Live production cutover Complete claimed by CI
